title: Principles of Economic Inequality Dynamics the Economic Dynamics and (Beyond) Standard Model (IV)
content: Inequality is always a serious concern of political economics. Nevertheless, the mainstream economics mostly focus on efficiency. The present paper aims to postulate new model of inequality and pareto efficiency. The general relativity theory will be used as a referential framework from modeling perspective. The economic inequality is characterized in a curved space and the Pareto efficiency is modeled as the geodesics. We provide certain details for constructing such a model mathematically. The contents of this paper are as follows. Section 1. Curved Spacetime in Economics and Why. Section 2. Macro-Externality and Full-Dimensional Individual Differences. Section 3. Economic Polarizability: The Invisible Hand as a Tensor. Section 4.   Economic Space with Local Curvilinear Coordinates. Section 5. Pareto Efficiency, Geodesics, and Economic Gravity. Section 6 provides remarks in conclusion.
